description: Extract a public URL and return its content as plain text, markdown or HTML using Desearch. Markdown keeps headings, lists and tables. Text is the page's main content; set full_page for every section, such as opening hours or fee tables. A js_required error means the page needs js: true; blocked means the site refused or showed a bot check. Preferred over web-crawl for new integrations. API docs: https://www.desearch.ai/docs/api-reference/get-web-extract

format.description: Content format to return: 'text' (default), 'markdown' (headings, lists, tables and code) or 'html'.

full_page.description: Only with format 'text': return all visible text of the page (every section, table and notice) instead of only its main content.

js.description: Render JavaScript before reading the page.

wait.description: Post-load wait in milliseconds when JavaScript rendering is enabled.

name: extract
title: Extract Page Content
